Guide claim re-checked read-only on existing system links, on CLI PHP 8.5.2 and on FrankenPHP php-cli 8.5.11 with identical results (scratchpad/d7fixrev/ro_link_probe.php). The junctions 'C:\Users\Default User' and 'C:\Documents and Settings' give is_link=false, filetype='unknown', lstat type 000000, is_dir=false. The dir symlink 'C:\Users\All Users' gives is_link=true, filetype='link', lstat 120000. The real dir 'C:\Users\Public' gives filetype='dir', lstat 040000. RecursiveDirectoryIterator::hasChildren() is false for the junction and the dir symlink and true for real dirs. The lstat-based filetype()==='dir' guard therefore stays off junctions and links, and the CHILD_FIRST walk does not descend into them.

Not reusing Illuminate is justified: vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Filesystem/Filesystem.php:751 deleteDirectory() recurses on isDir() && !isLink(), the same guard the leader's first prototype proved walks through a junction. No native recursive delete exists in laravel_main/app (no CHILD_FIRST anywhere). The patch therefore does not duplicate a safe existing helper.

issues: laravel-api-D7-B1 still open (owner pycore-laravel): poly_apps/laravel_main/app/Utils/FileSystemManager.php:602-636 delete() is sudo-only, so it does nothing on Windows. Fix: after :606-608, add 'if (\App\Providers\PathMapper::isWindows()) { return self::deleteNative($mappedPath); }'. deleteNative walks CHILD_FIRST only when @filetype($path)==='dir', with try/catch UnexpectedValueException. removeNativeEntry does unlink||rmdir plus a chmod retry, then return !file_exists. Keep LF and leave the POSIX path unchanged. Then run the stated checks and restart the FrankenPHP workers.
non_blocking: FileSystemManager.php:460, :471, :480: internal self::delete($temporaryPath) calls (concat temp cleanup) also change from a no-op to a real delete on Windows. The report's blast radius names only :408. The re-review should cover them along with the 45 external calls.

Patch detail (reports/pycore-lead.md removeNativeEntry): the read-only retry is '@chmod($path, 0666); @unlink($path);', so only files are retried. A directory that still carries the Windows read-only attribute stays. Retry 'if (@unlink($path) || @rmdir($path))' after the chmod as well. It costs nothing and covers both.

Record the reuse decision in the report: Illuminate Filesystem::deleteDirectory (vendor .../Filesystem.php:751) uses the unsafe isDir()&&!isLink() guard, which is why FileSystemManager gets its own native walk (AGENTS.md reuse rule). Informational for pycore-laravel: File::deleteDirectory callers such as Providers/GlobalVar.php:165 and Http/EnvironmentApiInfo/ClipboardController.php:104, :109 share the junction hazard on Windows.

Prune verification: the item's cap ('never exceed terminal_retention minus the 4 existing') allows at most 1 scratch terminal session, and with only 1 nothing gets pruned. The leader's back-dating approach is the sound way to resolve this, but the report does not record it as a deviation from the item's cap. The member must back-date scratch updated_at to earlier than 2026-09-26T15:04:41+00:00, in the same ISO-8601 '+00:00' format, because arsort compares strings. It must also confirm that the 4 real ids and their locks are byte-identical afterwards.

The report's prototype JSON leaves out the top_dir_symlink_created and top_file_symlink_created keys. If symlink() had failed, the top-level symlink cases would pass trivially, because deleteNative on a missing path returns true. Developer Mode is on (AllowDevelopmentWithoutDevLicense=1), and the nested symlink cases report created=true, so the cases were most likely exercised. The member's run should still print every *_created flag.
